assets: Original procedural textures and geometry; existing OpenStreetMap footprint credits retained.
albertPark: Mapped lake and islands; approximate Melbourne skyline silhouettes and event dressing, with golden-hour lighting per the user brief. Tree species are represented by generic broadleaf and palm artwork.
shanghai: Corrected using the two user-supplied photographs and mapped roof/building outlines: cream funnel canopies at H/K, enclosed viewing bridges over the main straight, and pit/main-stand sides aligned with the map. Procedural cladding, crowds, windows and branding remain approximations; original track and rain effects are unchanged.
suzuka: Mapped Circuit Wheel, main stand and pit positions; original procedural wheel, rides, tiered stands, hillside crowds, crossover structure, hills, gravel, trees and event props. Terrain between sampled track elevations, ride silhouettes and architectural detailing are artistic approximations; centreline, driving surface, car and physics are unchanged.
bahrain: Mapped Sakhir Tower, paddock and stand positions; procedural sail shades, LED bands, desert terrain, oasis gardens, blue/white wave runoff, regional branding and 495 visual floodlight poles. Six nearby pooled lights illuminate the scene; two cast shadows. Twilight fades to night over six minutes. Runoff walls share rendering/collision boundaries. Distant city/oilfield silhouettes, runoff decorations and architecture details are artistic approximations; track mesh and car are unchanged.
